title: Manhwa-Based Live-Action Series The Blue Road Releases Teaser Trailer Ahead of November 20 Premiere
content:
Netflix released a teaser trailer for The Blue Road , the manhwa -based live-action series , on Thursday. The series will premiere on Netflix on November 20 at 1:00 a.m. PST.

The teaser trailer introduces Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency detective Seok Kim (Seok-gu Son) and Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department detective Inose ( Eita Nagayama ) as they investigate what appears to be a series of connected murders in South Korea and Japan. Messages left at the crime scenes in both languages and disagreements over the investigation's direction set the stage for tensions between the two detectives.

Joon-hee Han, who previously helmed D.P. and Coin Locker Girl , is directing the series.

The live-action adaptation is based on the 2002 Korean-Japanese collaborative comic Purungil – Ao no Michi (Blue Road), written by Keishi Edogawa and drawn by Korean artist Kaya Kwon. The five-volume series blended hard-boiled crime storytelling with themes of cultural tension and cross-border cooperation, making it a distinctive work of its time.

The manhwa follows the investigation of a gruesome cross-border serial murder case. The story begins in Tokyo, where authorities discover a twisted, contorted corpse accompanied by a blood-written message in Korean. Shortly afterward, a similar crime scene emerges in South Korea—this time with a Japanese message written near the victim. The shocking parallels force law enforcement in both countries to recognize the crimes as linked, leading two detectives, one Korean and one Japanese, to join forces in pursuit of the killer.
author: ANN

title: Takopi’s Original Sin Movie Reveals Main Trailer With New Scenes, Key Visual and Tele Theme Song
content:
Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- movie revealed a new key visual and main trailer ahead of its November 27, 2026 release in Japan. The anime originally ran from June 28 to August 1. It swept the weekly rankings every week during its run, taking five wins. The film will compile all six episodes of the anime series as a re-edited version created specifically for theaters and feature new scenes. The film’s theme song has also been announced as “Rabyu,” a new song written by Tele specifically for the movie.

The new trailer features some of the newly added scenes, as well as a preview of Tele’s theme song. You can check it out below.

The English dub for the anime was released in January 2026. You can see the new key visual drawn by character designer Keita Nagahara below.

The main staff working on Takopi’s Original Sin includes:

• Director: Shinya Iino

• Series Composition: Shinya Iino

• Character Design: Keita Nagahara

• Animation Studio: ENISHIYA

• Production: TBS Television

You can also watch the final PV below. It was released immediately after the finale aired in Japan.

Taizan 5 wrote and illustrated the Takopi’s Original Sin (Takopi no Genzai) manga. It was published on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ platform from December 2021 to March 2022, getting a total of 2 compiled volumes. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English, describing the story:

Cute little alien Takopi lands on Earth. What is his mission? To be taken to our leader? No. To spread happiness throughout the universe! The first person Takopi meets is depressed fourth grader Shizuka. (Or is it…?) Takopi is determined to do whatever it takes to make Shizuka smile again. But his misguided attempts to help her by using his advanced technology to turn back time only result in mayhem and death. What is the truth Takopi can’t remember? And what must the pink alien octopus with a heart of gold sacrifice to truly help Shizuka and her friends…?
author: Anime Corner

title: Kazumi Yamashita's Twisted Sisters Manga Ends With 11th Volume
content:
The 10th compiled book volume of Kazumi Yamashita 's Twisted Sisters manga revealed on Thursday that the manga's 11th volume will be the final volume. The volume is scheduled to ship sometime early next spring.

The story follows manga artist Rikako, who reunites with her estranged sisters over their dying father's will. The will demands the five sisters live together in a mansion and she discovers a secret sister she's never met.

Yamashita launched the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in June 2021. The manga is inspiring a live-action series that will debut in January 2027.

Yamashita launched the Land manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine March 2014, and ended it in July 2020. Kodansha shipped the 11th and final volume in September 2020. Yen Press publishes the series in English.

Yen Press is also publishing Yamashita's Wonder Boy manga in English.

title: Ghost in the Shell New Anime Project by Science SARU Announced
content:
A new Ghost in the Shell anime project based on Masamune Shirow’s manga has officially entered production, with Science SARU once again handling the animation production.

The project was revealed as a surprise with a flyer distributed to attendees at a press preview for “OPEN HOUSE,” a public event being held at DOVER STREET MARKET GINZA in Tokyo on October 24. A new announcement visual was also released.

Science SARU previously animated the THE GHOST IN THE SHELL anime, which began airing and streaming in July 2026. The full staff for the first anime included:

• Director: Mokochan

• Script: EnJoe Toh

• Character Design & Executive Animation Director: Shuhei Handa

• Art Direcotor: Emi Katanosaka

• Art Supervisor: Osamu Masuyama

• Color Design: Satoshi Hashimoto

• Compositing Director: Hikari Itoh

• Editor: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Yuji Tange

• Sound Effect: Shota Yaso

• Sound Mix: Hiroaki Ota

• Music Director & Music: Taisei Iwasaki

• Music: Ryo Konishi, YUKI KANESAKA

• Animation Production: Science SARU

• Produced by: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL COMMITTEE

• Title Logo Design: Hajime Sorayama

Ghost in the Shell is a Japanese cyberpunk franchise created by Masamune Shirow. It began as a manga series serialized from 1989 to 1991, following Major Motoko Kusanagi, a cybernetically enhanced government agent in a futuristic society where technology and consciousness intertwine. The original manga has several sequels, including:

• Ghost in the Shell 1.5: Human-Error Processor

• Ghost in the Shell 2: Man-Machine Interface

• The Human Algorithm (a recent sequel launched in 2019 by Junichi Fujisaku)

The franchise is best known globally for its anime adaptations, beginning with the 1995 film directed by Mamoru Oshii. It was followed by:

• Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence (2004)

• The acclaimed Stand Alone Complex TV series (2002–2005) and its follow-up film Solid State Society

• The Arise reboot series (2013–2015)

• The Netflix original SAC_2045 (2020–2022)

In 2017, a Hollywood live-action film starring Scarlett Johansson was released.

Science SARU also recently animated Jaadugar: A Witch’s Life in Mongol , which premiered on July 4.
author: Anime Corner

title: Though I am an Inept Villainess Anime's 2nd Part Streams Teaser Video
content:
The website for the television anime of Satsuki Nakamura 's Though I Am an Inept Villainess ( Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga - Sūgū Chōso Torikae Den ) light novel series revealed a teaser promotional video on Friday for the show's second cours (quarter of a year), titled "The First Royal Outing" arc.

The second cours will debut in January 2027.

New cast members include:

• Yūichi Nakamura as Rerien's eldest brother Keikou

• Shunichi Toki as Rerien's second-eldest brother Keishou

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Unran, the young leader of a village

Seven Seas Entertainment publishes both the light novels and manga under the title Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court , and describes the story:

In a kingdom inspired by historical China, five clans put forth their maidens as imperial consorts–but only one will be crowned empress. The frail and beautiful Kou Reirin, the so-called “butterfly” of the imperial court, is a shoo-in to marry the crown prince. But when “court rat” Shu Keigetsu lashes out at her during the glittering Lantern Festival, it's Reirin who wakes up in the dungeons! Body-swapped by her assailant to steal her position at court, Reirin's plight seems dire...to everyone else! Now that she's got a robust new body, not even the looming threat of execution can stop her!

Mitsue Yamazaki ( How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift? , Monthly Girls' Nozaki-kun ) is directing the anime at Dōga Kōbō . Yoshiko Nakamura ( Detective Conan: Zero's Tea Time ; Tadaima, Okaeri ; The Helpful Fox Senko-san ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Ai Kikuchi ( How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift? , New Game! , Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie ) is designing the characters.

Additional staff members include:

• Color Key Artist: Kei Ishiguro

• Art Director: Seina Yaguchi (Studio Pablo)

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yui Fukuoka

• Editing: Mutsumi Takemiya

• Music: Yukari Hashimoto

• Casting: Makoto Tanimura

• Sound Effects: Yuika Shiraishi

• Audio-Recording Engineer: Toshihiro Hayano

• Recording Assistant: Ryō Kaneko

• Sound Production: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation

The anime premiered on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on July 12. Netflix began streaming the anime in Asia on July 12. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, and the Indian Subcontinent. TOHO debuted an English dub on July 25 on Crunchyroll , Hulu , and Disney+ . The dub is also available on Netflix in Asia.

The anime's premiere was delayed to July due to delays in production progress. The anime was initially announced to premiere in April.

Singer-songwriter milet performed the opening theme song "Sunny" for the first part, and Rokudenashi performed the ending theme song "Shooting Star" (Hōkiboshi).

Ichijinsha launched Nakamura's light novel series with illustrations by YukiKana in December 2020. The novels' manga adaptation by Ei Ohitsuji simultaneously launched in Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine. The series entered its final arc "Hoshi ni Negai o" (Wish Upon a Star) with the 13th light novel volume on September 30.

Seven Seas released the manga's ninth volume on August 4 and released the light novels' 11th volume in English on September 22.

title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' Anime Project in Production
content:
The Dover Street Market Ginza Open House public event announced on Friday that a new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) anime project is in production, revealing an announcement visual (pictured). Animation studio Science SARU will be producing the new anime project.

Produced by Science SARU, the 10-episode season adapting Masamune Shirow 's sci-fi action manga premiered in Summer 2026. Amazon Prime Video streamed the anime with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

The latest installment in the franchise, Koukaku Kidoutai: SAC_2045 - Saigo no Ningen ( Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 - The Last Human ), compiling the second season of the Koukaku Kidoutai: SAC_2045 ( Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 ) 3DCG anime series, opened in Japan in November 2023.

Synopsis With the substantial advancement in cybernetic and AI technology in the early 21st century, humans are able to modify their bodies to the limit, making the world nothing like before. In 2029, the Japanese metropolis of Newport City has become a grand stage for criminals who abuse the advanced technology for personal gain and try to attain power over others by any means necessary.

After making a name for herself and getting the green light from Public Security, determined Motoko Kusanagi takes charge of a new special forces unit. In these turbulent times, she and her subordinates tackle serious cybercrime cases that ordinary police would have no chance of solving. Although boasting a successful track record so far, Kusanagi and her unit soon learn there may be an elusive mastermind behind the scenes, whose actions further endanger the metropolis' fragile status quo. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
author: MyAnimeList

title: Made in Abyss Theatrical Series Part 2 Announced, New Key Visual Revealed
content:
The second installment in the new Made in Abyss theatrical series is officially in production, continuing the story after the first film, Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery ). The first film opened in Japan on October 23, 2026.

A new key visual was also released to commemorate the opening of Part 1. It features Srajo and the members of her Curse Fleet, Hail Hex. Additional cast members were also revealed:

• Yume Miyamoto as Menae

• Nana Mizuki as Srajo

• Akeno Watanabe as Nishagora

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Yataramaru

• Nao Toyama as Sherumi

You can see the new visual below.

Picking up directly after the events of Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun , the first film follows Riko, Reg, Nanachi, and Faputa as they descend into the Abyss’ seventh layer. Kinema Citrus returns as the animation studio, continuing its involvement from the previous entries in the series. The staff includes:

• Animation Production: Kinema Citrus

• Director: Masayuki Kojima

• Screenplay: Hideyuki Kurata

• Character Design: Yuka Kuroda, Kazuchika Kise (Production I.G)

The film’s theme song, “Chain of the Abyss,” is performed by composer Kevin Penkin featuring Mori Calliope. The latest trailer previewed the song, along with introducing Tepasté, voiced by Sumire Morohoshi, and Cravali, voiced by Takanori Hoshino.

Made in Abyss , written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, follows the descent of a girl named Riko and a robot boy named Reg into the Abyss, a massive pit filled with ancient relics and mysterious creatures. The manga is serialized on Takeshobo’s Web Comic Gamma and has over 22 million circulating copies.

A film concert titled Made in Abyss Film Concert: Deep Echoes of Resonance was held today on February 8, 2026 at Tokyo’s Nakano ZERO Grand Hall. Composer Kevin Penkin conducted a live orchestra performing the anime’s soundtrack, accompanied by anime footage on a large screen. Vocalist Ko Saito and KIHOW (MYTH & ROID), who performed the series’ theme songs, also appeared for live performances. Main cast members Miyu Tomita (Riko), Mariya Ise (Reg), and Shiori Izawa (Nanachi) were also present.
author: Anime Corner

title: Science Saru's The Ghost in the Shell Gets New Anime Project
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Friday that a new anime project is underway for The Ghost in the Shell ( Kōkaku Kidōtai THE GHOST IN THE SHELL ) television anime from Science SARU . The announcement did not state the format of the new anime, but confirmed Science SARU will again animate the work.

The announcement was first made on Friday at the Dover Street Market Ginza's open house press preview for the "Geeks Rule" apparel product launch.

The anime starred:

• Maaya Sakamoto as Motoko Kusanagi

• Kazuhiro Yamaji as Daisuke Aramaki

• Hiroki Yasumoto as Batou

• Yūichi Nakamura as Togusa

• Kōsuke Gotō as Ishikawa

• Tōru Nara as Saito

• Marie Ōi as Operator

• Tomoko Kaneda as Fuchikoma

• Chafūrin as Minister of Home Affairs

• Naomi Kusumi as Volgarena Representative

• Hiroshi Yanaka as Vice Minister Ito

• Tomoko Miyadera as Union Leader

• Atsushi Miyauchi as Borma

• Kenichi Ogata as Col. Tonoda

• Masashi Ebara as Hanka Precision Instruments President

• Aya Hisakawa as Annapuma

• Niina Kumagaya as Unipuma

Mokochan (storyboarder, key animator for DAN DA DAN , The Heike Story , Tatami Time Machine Blues ) made his directorial debut with the anime at Science SARU . Toh Enjoe ( The Empire of Corpses novelist; Space Dandy , Godzilla Singular Point scripts) both wrote and oversaw the series scripts. Shūhei Handa ( Little Witch Academia TV series, Scott Pilgrim Takes Off , Spriggan (ONA) ) designed the characters and also served as chief animation director. Taisei Iwasaki ( BELLE ) served as music director, and composed the music along with Ryō Konishi ( Journal with Witch theme song) and Yuki Kanesaka ( Dr. Stone ).

Additional staff members include:

• Art Director: Emi Katanosaka

• Art Supervision: Osamu Masuyama

• Color Key Artist: Satoshi Hashimoto

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hikari Itō

• Editor: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Yuji Tange

• Sound Effects: Shota Yaso

• Recording: Yasuaki Ōta

• Music Production: Flying Dog

King Gnu performed the opening theme song "Go Ghost." MILLENNIUM PARADE feat. Saya Gray , Daniel Caesar performed the ending theme song "Blue."

Bandai Namco Filmworks , Kodansha , Science SARU , and Production I.G are on the production committee for the anime.

title: Shōya Ishige Joins Cast of Wound & Bandage TV Anime
content:
The official website for television anime of Umihoshi Nanai 's Wound & Bandage ( Kizuguchi to Hōtai ) manga streamed a second teaser promotional video on Friday, which reveals that Shōya Ishige will voice Ginsuke Hatobane in the series.

The anime stars Hisako Kanemoto as Riyo Washizu, and Chikahiro Kobayashi as Gō Kiritani.

Miyuki Ishida ( I.Cinnamoroll , director, One Punch Man season 2 and 3 episode director) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Susumu Yamakawa ( The Way of the Househusband three seasons, Murai in Love ) is writing the scripts, and Natsuki Ōyama ( Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive? ) is designing the characters.

The romantic comedy centers on Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the leader of the yakuza organization that occupies the Kanto region of Japan. Gō Kiritani, a young subordinate in the organization, becomes Riyo's caretaker. He expects her to be just a docile child, but he soon learns that Riyo has a certain fetish — she loves seeing strong people when they are weak.

The manga debuted on Kodansha 's Comic Days app in August 2024. Kodansha shipped the fifth volume on July 16.

title: New Votoms Anime Films' Teaser Reveals Theme Song
content:
The staff for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise , unveiled a new visual and teaser trailer for the films on Friday. The teaser reveals and previews the first film's theme song "Na mo Naki Shijin no Yō ni" (Like Some Nameless Poet) by Mika Nakashima . Toshihiko Takamizawa , the vocalist and guitarist for the band THE ALFEE , wrote, composed, and arranged the song.

The staff also revealed a new trailer for the film.

The first film will open in Japan on November 20.

Miyuki Sawashiro plays Ash Vamps (left in visual right), a notorious and feared AT pilot called the Grey Witch. Mabuki Andou plays Maki Stauffenberg (right), an officer secretly assigned to look into Ash's past.

Other cast members include:

• Shinichirō Miki as Alix Barrack

• Yūki Kaji as Ignis Schweinsteiger

• Yūichi Nakamura as Fritz Gersdorf

• Satoshi Tsuruoka as Brunhart Müller

• Tomokazu Sugita as Adrian Dysler

• Kenta Miyake as Matt Hummels

• Chafūrin as Soltig van Gunnar

• Hōchū Ōtsuka as Vid Hildebrandt

• Daisuke Ono as Meteusz Julian Podolsky

• Takayuki Sugō as Weissweiler

• Takahiro Sakurai as Oliver

• Sumire Uesaka as Maintenance Girl

Mamoru Oshii is directing the two films. Ryōsuke Takahashi , director and creator of the original concept for the original 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime, is supervising the films. Shinobu Tsuneki ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These , Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Kaiju No. 8 ) and Sōkō Kihei Votoms: AT Stories manga artist Yoshiro Sōno are the mechanical designers. Kenji Kawai , who has worked with Oshii in various projects including Ghost in the Shell and Patlabor 2: The Movie , is composing the music.

Other staff include:

• Original Character Design Concepts: Kazuchika Kise (xxxHOLiC, Made in Abyss, Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot)

• Character Design: Shingo Ogiso, Takashi Kojima, Tetsuya Nishio

• Original Mechanical Designer: Kunio Ōkawara

• Mechanical Design: Jū Ishiguchi, Wataru Inada

• Costume Design Assistance: Katsuya Terada

• Art Design: Satoshi Takabatake, Yasumitsu Suetake, Kazushige Kanehira

• Art Director: Yūshi Honjō

• Color Key Artist: Nagisa Abe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūki Kawashita

• CG Directors: Yōta Tasaki, Toshihisa Yokoshima, Jō Nakajima

• Editing: Aya Hida

• Sound Director: Kazuhiro Wakabayashi

The 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime is an iconic entry in the so-called "real robot" subgenre of mecha pioneered by Mobile Suit Gundam , characterized by robots as mass-produced military machines (with limitations in operation akin to real-life war machines) and gritty and grounded stories about war and its bitter costs.

The original 1983 anime is set during the ebb of a century-long conflict between the two nations of the Gilgamesh Confederation and the Balarant Union. The unit that dominates the battlefield is the VOT OMS (Vertical One-man Tank for Offense & Maneuvers), a class of powerful yet extremely vulnerable mecha , known as much for their firepower as they are for the high casualty numbers of their pilots due to thin armor and lack of safety measures. The protagonist, Chirico Cuvie, is a member of an elite Gilgamesh VOT OMS unit that becomes a pawn in a vast conspiracy that brands him a traitor to Gilgamesh, and leads him to cross paths with a mysterious woman.

Section23 Films ' Maiden Japan label most recently released the original anime on Blu-ray Disc in 2019 and 2020.

The original series has inspired a number of spinoff anime, including Armored Trooper Votoms: The Last Red Shoulder , Armored Trooper Votoms: Big Battle , Armor Hunter Mellowlink , Armored Trooper Votoms: Red Shoulder Document - Roots of Treachery , Armored Trooper Votoms: Pailsen Files , Armored Trooper Votoms: The Heretic Saint , and Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again . Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again , the latest entry in the series until now, debuted in 2011.
